## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Barcelona, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 3.0 km. It starts at Palau de la Música Catalana, C/ Palau de la Música, 4-6, Ciutat Vella, 08003 Barcelona, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Palau de la Música Catalana. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Anna as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Ticket to Palau de la Música Catalana is included in this self-guided walking audio tour of Barcelona, ideal for first-time visitors interested in history, architecture, art, and the city’s distinct Catalan identity. Please note that an audio tour inside Palau de la Música Catalana is not provided within this bundle.
>
> After you finish exploring Palau de la Música on your own, unpause this tour and continue to Arc de Triomf and Ciutadella Park, where the city’s 1888 exhibition era and public spaces come into focus. From there, the walk leads into the Born district to Santa Maria del Mar and the Picasso Museum, before entering the Gothic Quarter at the Cathedral of Barcelona and the mosaic mural The World Comes to Life With Each Kiss. The route then opens into Plaça de Catalunya and continues along Passeig de Gràcia to Casa Batlló.
>
> The tour ends at La Pedrera - Casa Milà, where Barcelona’s modernisme reaches one of its most daring expressions. Along the way, travelers will remember the stained-glass splendor of the Palau, the red-brick arch of the Universal Exposition, the calm of Ciutadella Park, the soaring Gothic interiors of Santa Maria del Mar and the cathedral, the surprise of contemporary art beside medieval streets, and Gaudí’s dreamlike façades.
